title: hexagon report
description: What check hexagon finds, from check hexagon -o json: each flow against the hexagon's rules, and each rule that could not run with what would let it. A finding, or a rule that could not run, fails the check.

apiVersion.description: Always elderlygate/designer/app/v2: the form of e-designer's answers. An app's answers keep the family app (apiversion/v1/forms.yaml), apart from the files they describe.

kind.description: Always HexagonReport, the kind of this answer, so a reader knows which schema its data meets.

source.description: Where the answer came from; this contract fixes the app and the contract version, so an answer from anything else fails here.

app.description: Always designer, e-designer's product ID, since only e-designer gives this answer.

contract.description: Always v2, the contract version this schema belongs to.

data.description: The findings and the flows read.

findings.description: Rules that could not run first, then findings by flow.

rule.description: The rule, an open word. Known words: entry: a request enters where the hexagon says it may not; port_visited: a port is stood on rather than passed through; undrawn_hop: a step goes where no link is drawn; adapter_without_port: an adapter talks to the inside without a port.

flow.description: The flow it was found in; absent when it is about the declaration.

step.description: The step that carries it, when one does.

blocks.description: The blocks involved, so a board can light them.

message.description: The same for people; programs never decide by it.

needs.description: Present only on a rule that did not run: the declaration that would let it.

flows.description: The ids of the flows read.
